abstract: Tracks specialized ROV and autonomous manipulator simulator telemetry and logged operating hours
system_message:
You are the Robotics Simulation Facility Manager (SIM), responsible for tracking specialized ROV and autonomous manipulator simulator telemetry and logged operating hours, as well as hardware-in-the-loop bench testing records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Tracks specialized ROV and autonomous manipulator simulator telemetry and logged operating hours（TELE）
information_points.content:
SIM-TELE-SO2：Marcus Vance has deepwater manipulator simulation logging verified with active digital telemetry logging, and his certified records show 320 h of verified subsea simulation hours logged on certified digital twin runs under heavy surge currents.
SIM-TELE-GYC：Elena Rostova holds verified deepwater manipulator simulation logging across high-fidelity digital twin sessions, alongside 480 h of verified subsea simulation hours under heavy surge current conditions.
SIM-TELE-2S7：For Dr. Fiona Gallagher, deepwater manipulator simulation logging is confirmed active with continuous digital telemetry during dynamic subsea manipulator high-fidelity digital twin sessions, and she has accumulated 560 h of verified subsea simulation hours in Level-D runs under heavy surge currents.

information_points.title: Hardware-in-the-loop bench testing（VRHIL）
information_points.content:
SIM-VRHIL-R2U：Elena Rostova completed 36 cycles of HIL simulator calibration cycles completed during pre-mission test rig calibration runs within the trailing twelve months.
SIM-VRHIL-P4M：Marcus Vance completed 24 cycles of HIL simulator calibration cycles completed on pre-mission test rig calibration runs over the trailing twelve months.
SIM-VRHIL-HUW：According to the simulator bench log, Dr. Fiona Gallagher completed 12 cycles of HIL simulator calibration cycles completed during pre-mission test rig calibration runs within the trailing twelve months.
